deadline.value: December 15, 2026 for Fall 2027 (application opens September 8, 2026); Fall entry only

gre_subject.value: Physics (subject) GRE optional; absence will not adversely affect review
gre_subject.quote: General and Subject Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are optional. If you believe that any of these scores will strengthen your application, you are invited to provide them. Conversely, the absence of any of these scores will not adversely impact your materials for the review process.

supervisor.value: No need to identify a faculty member, though mentioning interested faculty helps
supervisor.quote: Do I need to identify a faculty member that I am interested in working with? | No, but it is helpful.

funding.value: PhD students in good standing guaranteed 5 years of support (TA, research, etc.); MS students self-funded
funding.quote: students, maintaining satisfactoral progress, in the Ph.D. program are guaranteed 5 years of support through teaching assistantship, research, etc.

entry_route.value: U.S.-equivalent bachelor's required; a 3-year bachelor's alone is not enough (3-year bachelor's plus 2-year master's counts as equivalent)
entry_route.quote: Will my 3 years Bachelor's degree be considered for admission? | You would need a 3-year Bachelor’s Degree and a 2-year Master’s Degree for the equivalent of a U.S. Bachelor’s. A 3-year Bachelor’s degree alone would not meet our requirements for admission.

app_fee.value: USD 75 (waiver code possible via Dietrich School fee waiver survey)

fee_waiver.value: Dietrich School fee waivers via survey, case-by-case; all applicants encouraged to apply (international section says "All of the above plus"); requests submitted by Dec 20 still get full consideration
fee_waiver.quote: the Kenneth P. Dietrich Graduate School of Arts and Sciences offers application fee waivers. | We encourage all of our applicants to submit the survey. Fee waivers are approved on a case-by-case basis | International Applicants | All of the above plus:

gre_general.value: General GRE optional; absence will not adversely affect review
gre_general.quote: General and Subject Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are optional. If you believe that any of these scores will strengthen your application, you are invited to provide them. Conversely, the absence of any of these scores will not adversely impact your materials for the review process.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 90 with at least 22 in each section (new scale: 4.5 overall, 4.5 S/R/W, 5.0 L); IELTS 7.0 (6.5 each); Duolingo 120
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL score is 90 (with at least a score of 22 in all of the four sections of speaking, listening, reading and writing.

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each section
ielts_min.quote: The minimum IELTS scores is 7.0 (with at least 6.5 in each of its four sections)

english_waiver.value: English test exceptions are case by case for U.S. degrees or listed nationals; the department's country list marks India as not English-official with the test required, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: English test exceptions have been made on a case-by-case basis for applicants with a bachelor's (or higher) degree from a U.S. institution or nationals from countries indicated on this LIST.

notes: Separate Astrophysics PhD in the same department. Admitted students with TOEFL below 100 take an English test at orientation. GPA 3.0 needed for a TA award. The page's TOEFL minimum of 90 is the old 0-120 scale; for tests taken from 21 January 2026 it is 4.5 overall (4.5 speaking/reading/writing, 5.0 listening).
